programme.desc: (1963) Western starring John Wayne, Maureen O'Hara and Patrick Wayne. A wealthy rancher must navigate warring factions in the Wild West while also fighting to save his troubled marriage.

programme.title: Fortress
programme.desc: Fortress is an all-out-action cyber thriller from the producers of Lone Survivor and The Irishman and starring the action powerhouse Bruce Willis, Escape Plan II's Jesse Metcalfe, One Tree Hill's Chad Michael Murray and Shannen Doherty (90210, Charmed).

programme.title: The Big Short
programme.desc: When the banks committed the greatest fraud in US history, four outsiders risked it all to take them down. Based on the unbelievable true story and best-selling book from the author of The Blind Side and Moneyball, critics are calling The Big Short “brilliant and explosive”...

programme.title: Sin City 2: A Dame to Kill For
programme.desc: In a town where justice doesn't prevail, the desperate want vengeance and ruthless murderers find themselves with vigilantes on their heels. Their paths cross in Sin City's famous Kadie's Club Pecos.

programme.title: Hunting Games
programme.desc: After a bag of stolen of money is unexpectedly lost during Law enforcement intervention, a group of hired ex-military is brought in to bring it back. A predicted easy mission is interrupted by a lone hunter, Will, who finds the bag and decides to keep it for himself.

programme.title: Phantom Racer
programme.desc: When former friends and rival Nascar racers JJ SAWYER and CUTTER MCCONAUGHEY collide in a fiery accident on the track, only JJ survives. Sixteen years later, he is a guilt-ridden ‘truckie' transporting race cars from track to track without a life. Unexpectedly stopping in his home town, JJ discovers that Cutter's race car has been completely restored and now, because of JJ's presence, it comes alive, haunted by its old driver. The car wants revenge and it wants JJ. Mile after brutal mile the highway becomes a battleground, resulting in a final confrontation which must bring an end to the frightening rampage of the Phantom Racer.

programme.title: A Lonely Place to Die
programme.desc: A group of mountaineers in the Scottish Highlands discover a kidnapped girl and are pursued by her captors.

programme.title: Five Corners
programme.desc: After a two-year prison sentence, the violent psychopath Heinz returns to the Bronx in New York, where he lived before. His former victim Linda (Jodie Foster) still lives in the neighborhood. Heinz sets his eyes on her again. Fearing another assault, Linda turns to her former rescuer Harry (Tim Robbins), who does not see any danger. However, Linda's worst fears quickly become a reality.

programme.title: Swimfan
programme.desc: It's a teen thriller kind of like 'Fatal Attraction' where a high school senior who's rising in the swimming world has a one-night hookup that leads to some bad stuff...

programme.title: For the Love of Chocolate
programme.desc: As Aria gets ready for the yearly Masters of Chocolate Festival, things take a turn when her partner quits just before the big event. But soon, a charming single dad comes to her rescue, helping her discover the secret to winning.

programme.title: JFK
programme.desc: Obsessed with getting answers a district attorney risks his family, his career and his very life to find the truth of the JFK assassination.

programme.title: Birdman Or (The Unexpected Virtue of Ignorance)
programme.desc: In an effort to jumpstart his career after his superhero movie franchise dies, a psychotic actor writes, directs, and stars in a Broadway play that becomes an unlikely hit after he tries to shoot himself in the head during the premiere.

programme.title: Daybreakers
programme.desc: The year is 2019, and an unknown plague has transformed the world's population into blood-thirsty vampires. As humans and their blood become more scarce, vampires must search for new ways to satisfy their craving.

programme.title: Ginger Snaps
programme.desc: Two death-obsessed sisters must deal with the consequences when one of them is bitten by a deadly werewolf.

programme.title: Ginger Snaps 2: Unleashed
programme.desc: Brigitte is found by the police and taken to rehab when it's assumed that the wolfsbane serum is a narcotic.

programme.title: Ginger Snaps Back: The Beginning
programme.desc: Bridget and her sister are trapped in a fort that is besieged by werewolves.

programme.title: An American Werewolf in London
programme.desc: Two Americans on a tour of Britain are attacked by a werewolf that none of the locals will admit exists.

programme.title: The Way
programme.desc: Martin Sheen plays Tom, an American doctor who comes to France to collect the remains of his adult son who was killed in the Pyrenees in a storm while walking The Camino de Santiago - also known as 'The Way of Saint James'. Driven by his desire to understand his lost son, Tom decides to embark on the historical pilgrimage, leaving his California life behind. Armed only with his son's backpack and guidebook, he begins the 800km historical pilgrimage but soon discovers that he won't be alone on this journey - he meets other pilgrims from around the world, all broken and looking for greater meaning in their lives. From the hardship experienced along "The Way" an unlikely group of misfits are bonded and Tom begins to learn the difference between 'The life we live and the life we choose.'

programme.title: Call of The Wild
programme.desc: Call of The Wild is a modern-day story incorporating elements of Jack London's classic short novel. Whilst Ryann (Ariel Gade) is staying with her Grandpa Bill (Christopher Lloyd) a wild hybrid wolf/dog shows up injured on the back porch one night. Ryann and a local friend believe they can train the magnificent animal to become a sled dog leader but first they must try and persuade Grandpa, who knows the animal will eventually have to return to the wild. Then they must stand up to the local bully who wants to claim the dog as his own.

programme.title: G-Loc
programme.desc: In a world on the brink of environmental collapse, mass migration to neighbouring planet, Rhea, is humanity's final hope for survival. The only problem is, in the sixteen Earth years since the first humans landed on Rhea, two hundred and eighty-eight years have passed on the new planet and the existing population are no longer welcoming new arrivals, with the Rheans having set up a space blockade to shot down any ship that tries to cross into their territory. 'Earther', Bran, has big dreams of a better life in this new world, but the odds are stacked against him. Finding himself the lone survivor of a failed emigration attempt, his escape pod floats mindlessly in space and his oxygen is running low. His only chance of survival is to hook up to a rogue Rhean supply ship called The Nysa running on auxiliary power. But after finding the crew on board The Nysa dead, it seems Bran may have more than just a hostile planet to worry about. An intense interstellar thriller with an impressive cast, including Stephen Moyer (True Blood), Casper Van Dien (Starship Troopers) and John Rhys-Davies (the Indiana Jones and Lord of the Rings franchises).

programme.title: Queen of the Desert
programme.desc: A chronicle of Gertrude Bell's life, a traveler, writer, archaeologist, explorer, cartographer, and political attach for the British Empire at the dawn of the twentieth century.

programme.title: Centigrade
programme.desc: A married couple find themselves trapped in their frozen vehicle after a blizzard and struggle to survive amid plunging temperatures and unforeseen obstacles. At -40 degrees your lungs freeze and time is running out..

programme.title: Summoning
programme.desc: In 1930's Paris, American sisters and spiritual mediums Laura and Kate Barlow tour pre-war Europe, where curious spectators join them onstage for a hypnotic sance with the dead

programme.title: Killer Sofa
programme.desc: Best to not hide behind your sofa for this one! Killer Sofa does for chairs what Jaws did for sharks. When a killer Lazy Boy chair falls in love with a girl, its up to a disgraced Jewish Rabbi, a Voodoo sorceress and a couple of broken-hearted detectives to ?gure out how to stop the bloody carnage that will follow. This completely bonkers comedy horror is sofa-king-good!

programme.title: Escape Room
programme.desc: A mind-bending psychological thriller about a group of friends who find themselves in a sadistic, living nightmare. Six adventurous strangers travel to a mysterious building to experience a game where players compete to solve puzzles to win money. But what starts out as innocent fun soon turns into a suffocating and terrifying game of hell.

programme.title: The Joker
programme.desc: In this creepy and twisted thriller, a young detective is caught in a horrifically sadistic game of cat-and-mouse when he is kidnapped and tormented by a masked, sex-crazed, serial killer. With a deadly race against time, he only has one method to save himself and a young girl. Starring Ron Perlman (Hellboy) and Halston Sage (Bad Neighbours) this clever, nail-biting nightmare is not to be missed!

programme.title: The Public
programme.desc: The Public is about downtown Cincinnati librarians Stuart Goodson and Myra who see their regular winter day shaken up when homeless patrons decide to take shelter in their library for the night. What starts as a peaceful sit-in quickly escalates into a face-off with the police and the media.

programme.title: Close to You
programme.desc: Sam (Elliot Page) hasn't been home since his transition. After four years in Toronto, he takes a long-dreaded trip back to his hometown for his father's birthday.

programme.title: We Have Always Lived in the Castle
programme.desc: A twisted mystery based on the acclaimed novel by Shirley Jackson ('The Haunting of Hill House'). Merricat (Taissa Farmiga - 'The Nun') lives with her sister Constance (Alexandra Daddario - 'Baywatch') and her Uncle Julian (Crispin Glover - 'Back to the Future').

programme.title: Come Early Morning
programme.desc: A thirty-something southern woman searches for love, despite the burdens she carries with her.

programme.title: Rocky Mountain Christmas
programme.desc: (2017) Romance starring Lindy Booth. After a messy public break-up, a woman retreats to her uncle's ranch - where a run-in with a Hollywood actor sparks an unexpected connection.

programme.title: Christmas Truce
programme.desc: (2015) Romantic war drama with Craig Olejnik and Ali Liebert. After falling in love amid the Battle of the Bulge, a US soldier and a Belgian woman vow to reunite at war's end - if they survive...

programme.title: Mingle All the Way
programme.desc: (2018) Christmas romance with Jen Lilley. While testing her networking app, Molly finds an unlikely plus-one for the festive season. But will strictly business turn into something more?

programme.title: Candy Cane Christmas
programme.desc: (2020) Christmas romance with Beverley Mitchell. When her favourite tradition of decorating Candy Cane Lane is cancelled, can Phoebe find something - or someone - new to lift her Christmas spirits?

programme.title: Merry and Bright
programme.desc: Cate, the CEO of the Merry and Bright candy cane company, assumes her mother is playing matchmaker again when she meets Gabe in the run-up to Christmas. Stars Andrew Walker and Jodie Sweetin. (2019)

programme.desc: In her directorial debut, Greta Gerwig stars as Mattie, a New York resident who over the course of a year desperately tries to navigate through the struggles of a long-distance relationship with her partner, James, who lives in Chicago.

programme.title: I've Never Wanted Anyone More
programme.desc: Charming, passionate, and totally irresponsible Werther (Douglas Booth) meets lovely Charlotte (Alison Pill) by chance, and her allure and commitment to her impressive, stable fiancé Albert (Patrick J. Adams) turns Werther's life upside down.

programme.desc: Chiwetel Ejiofor (12 Years A Slave, Children of Men) and Thandie Newton (Crash, The Pursuit of Happyness) star in this epic chronicle of family ties and war from celebrated Nigerian playwright Biyi Bandele.

programme.title: The Flight Before Christmas
programme.desc: Starring Mayim Bialik and Ryan McPartlin. Two strangers offer to share the last remaining room at a bed-and-breakfast when a snowstorm strands their flight in Montana on Christmas Eve.

programme.title: Secret Lives of Second Wives
programme.desc: Lynn finds that marriage the second time around is far from idyllic when her husband's (Brian McNamara) ex-wife and children return to manipulate him.

programme.desc: A happy newlywed marriage counselor's views on wedded bliss get thrown for a loop when she finds out her parents are getting divorced. Starring: Mandy Moore, Kellan Lutz, James Brolin

programme.desc: When a 30-something woman living in an infinite state of youth is finally forced out into the real world, she befriends a young girl and a widower that will teach her that it is okay to grow up.

programme.title: Love Finds You in Sugarcreek
programme.desc: A father and son fleeing a shocking and brutal tragedy settle in the predominantly Amish town of Sugarcreek, Ohio. They are taken in by three sisters who offer the father work as a handyman, but a local policewoman begins to become suspicious of his past.

programme.title: Love On Harbor Island
programme.desc: Interior designer Lily returns home to help her Aunt Maggie run her marina-side bed and breakfast when she meets Marcus, a handsome seaplane pilot whose work delivering rescue dogs helps Lily discover that home really is where the heart is.

programme.title: Love's Portrait
programme.desc: Lily, a museum curator, discovers a painting that looks just like her and is sent to find where the painting came from and who painted it. She tracks the painting down to the post office it was sent from in Ireland. There she meets William and Saoirse, a brother-sister duo who run the post, and who offer her help and friendship on her quest. But William knows more than he's letting on. Will he reveal what he knows if it risks his growing relationship--and mutual love--with Lily?

programme.title: Calling For Love
programme.desc: Podcaster Sam Sanders is assigned to host a show that reunites lost loves. Even though Love is the last thing on her mind, Samantha falls for charming Jake who calls in with a problem. Will Samantha follow her heart this time?

programme.title: October Baby
programme.desc: As the curtain rises, Hannah hesitantly steps onto the stage for her theatrical debut in college. Yet before she can utter her first lines, Hannah-unscripted-collapses in front of the stunned audience. After countless medical tests, all signs point to one underlying factor: Hannah's difficult birth. This revelation is nothing compared to what she then learns from her parents: she was actually adopted ... after a failed abortion attempt. Bewildered, angered, and confused, Hannah turns for support to Jason, her long-time friend. Encouraged by his adventurous spirit, Hannah joins his group of friends on a Spring Break road trip, embarking on a journey to discover her hidden past ... and find hope for her unknown future. In the midst of her incredible journey, Hannah learns that every life is beautiful

But the turmoil of their romantic lives is nothing compared to what they are about to experience: they witness a murder and become targets of a contract killer.

Grant and Secretary of War William W. Belknap to stop bandits from crossing the Rio Grande into the United States, or from returning to Mexico.

programme.desc: Billy starts as an innocent outlaw protecting his mother but soon becomes a ruthless killer. When love gives him hope for change, Pat Garrett, a fatherly friend, helps him try to turn his life around. Yet fate drags Billy back into violence, and Garrett is ultimately credited with his death.

programme.desc: In 1867 Texas, after the Civil War, Colonel Thomas Blake and his men refuse to surrender, raiding Yankee towns. Rumors swirl that Blake kills for pleasure, not the Confederacy, leading to large bounties for his capture. However, Blake seeks $200,000 that vanished during the war from Confederate coffers. He sends Chamaco Gonzales to track down the missing fortune, hidden in General Beauregard's strong box.

programme.title: Those Dirty Dogs
programme.desc: Near Fort Apache, Mexican bandits raid a U.S. Army supply column, killing soldiers and kidnapping Miss Adams. To stop the raids, President Grant sends Captain Chadwell, Lieutenant Junger, Sergeant Smith, and bounty hunter Korano. Together, they face outlaw Angelo Sanchez and the mad General Mueller in a dangerous mission.

programme.title: Sarah Vaughan, Richard Davis, Ronnell Bright & Art Morgan
programme.desc: Sarah Vaughan: Live in '58 & 64 features the Divine One in her prime, wrapping her sultry voice around jazz standards such as “Lover Man”, “Misty”, and “I Got Rhythm” and popular showtunes such as “Over The Rainbow” and “Maria”. One of the greatest voices of the 20th Century, her renditions of songs by Harold Arlen, Leonard Bernstein, Johnny Burke, the Gershwins, and Stephen Sondheim are pure diva magic. These three performances demonstrate why Sarah Vaughan is invariably mentioned in the same breath as Ella Fitzgerald and Billie Holiday.

programme.title: Bill Evans
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Jazzmeia Horn
programme.desc: Vocalist Jazzmeia Horn's 2019 Malta Jazz Festival appearance was a celebration of jazz's future, infused with the soul of its past. Featuring Keith Brown (piano), Rashaan Carter (bass), Irwin Hall (flute and saxophone), and Anwar Marshall (drums), the young singer's performance was a reminder of jazz's enduring power to speak to the heart. Situated at the Valletta waterfront outside Our Lady of Liesse Church, Horn's concert was a truly spellbinding experience.

programme.title: Maynard Ferguson
programme.sub-title: Winter 1980: Maynard Ferguson Big Band in Brussels
programme.desc: The Brussels Jazz Club was filled to the brim with both musicians and audience members when the Maynard Ferguson Big Band performed there during their Winter Tour of 1980. From the first notes of the cover of Weather Report's “Birdland” that opens the performance to the final notes of “Gonna Fly Now” that closes it, Ferguson gives his young sidemen ample time to shine. The mutual admiration shared by the leader and his sidemen makes this performance a delight to watch.

programme.title: Idris Muhammad, Curtis Fuller, Joe Henderson & Kenny Drew
programme.desc: This assemblage of authentic luminaries recreates the sound of Paris in the 50's and 60's when the City of Light was Europe's mecca for American jazz musicians. The Paris Reunion Band was formed as homage to Kenny Clarke and the spirit of his fellow Paris jazzmen.

programme.title: Thelonious Monk
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Randy Brecker & Bennie Wallace
programme.sub-title: R. Brecker, B. Wallace and Band - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival's staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1987, American trumpeter Randy Brecker and saxophonist Bennie Wallace brought their band of pianist Elian Elias, drummer Peter Erskine and bassist Marc Johnson to the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague. Together they put on a stellar duo performance.

programme.title: Curtis Stigers
programme.sub-title: Curtis Stigers - Fly Me To The Moon
programme.desc: The Danish Radio Big Band joins forces with American vocalist Curtis Stigers to celebrate Frank Sinatra's iconic concerts at The Sands Hotel in Las Vegas. Curtis Stigers and the big band present the most popular evergreens from the American songbook of the 1950s and 1960s, one of which is the classic that lend the concert its name: “Fly Me To The Moon”.

programme.title: Jazzmeia Horn
programme.desc: Vocalist Jazzmeia Horn's 2019 Malta Jazz Festival appearance was a celebration of jazz's future, infused with the soul of its past. Featuring Keith Brown (piano), Rashaan Carter (bass), Irwin Hall (flute and saxophone), and Anwar Marshall (drums), the young singer's performance was a reminder of jazz's enduring power to speak to the heart. Situated at the Valletta waterfront outside Our Lady of Liesse Church, Horn's concert was a truly spellbinding experience.

programme.title: Richard Easley, Thornel Schwartz & Jimmy McGriff
programme.sub-title: Comblain-la-Tour Jazz Festival: Jimmy McGriff Trio
programme.desc: As one of the best Hammond B3 organ players, Jimmy McGriff (1936-2008) is often lost among great soul-jazz organists from his hometown of Philadelphia. Of the major soul-jazz pioneers, he was the bluesiest and often insisted that he was more of a blues musician than a jazz artist. Regardless, he remained eclectic enough to blur the lines of genres. His sound - deep, down-to-earth grooves drenched in blues and gospel feeling - made him popular with R&B audiences. This 1965 performance is part of the Comblain-la-Tour Jazz Festival.

programme.title: Iván Fischer & Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino
programme.sub-title: Mozart Symphony No. 34 & Dvořák Symphony No. 7
programme.desc: Maestro Iván Fischer leads the Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in a remarkable concert program of works by Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart and Antonín Dvořák. Mozart's Symphony No. 34 in C major, K. 338 opens the program. Completed in the summer of 1780, this was the last symphony Mozart wrote in Salzburg, where he worked as a court musician. The three-movement symphony features two vibrant outer movements with fanfares and rousing themes, while the quieter second movement is scored for strings alone, deviating from the typical four-movement structure of the time. Next on the program is Dvořák's Symphony No. 7 in D minor, Op. 70, completed in March 1885 and premiered one month later in London conducted by the composer himself. With its dramatic and dark style, this symphony stands in stark contrast to the predominantly optimistic tone of Dvořák's broader oeuvre. This performance was recorded at Teatro del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in Florence, Italy, on January 29, 2021.

programme.title: Danish National Symphony Orchestra, Fabio Luisi, Copenhagen Royal Chapel Choir & MDR Leipzig Radio Choir
programme.desc: Fabio Luisi conducts the Danish National Symphony Orchestra in a performance of Gustav Mahler's Symphony No. 8. The work is one of the largest-scale choral works in the classical concert repertoire and is frequently called the "Symphony of a Thousand." The work was composed at Mahler's Maiernigg villa in southern Austria in the summer of 1906 and is the last work which was premiered in Mahler's lifetime. Soloists include Ricarda Merbeth (soprano), Henriette Bonde-Hansen (soprano), Sofia Fomini (soprano), Marianne Beate Kielland (alto), Olesya Petrova (alto), Stefan Vinke (tenor), Russel Braun (baritone), and Günther Groissböck (bass). Among the participating choirs are the Danish National Concert Choir, MDR Leipzig Radio Choir and Copenhagen Royal Chapel Choir. Recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in 2017.

programme.title: Franz Welser-Möst & Cleveland Orchestra
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst leads the Cleveland Orchestra in a concert performing a charming work by Mozart, with a sentimental connection to the conductor: Symphony No. 36 'Linz is named after the hometown of Welser-Möst. Mozart wrote the piece when stopping over on a trip from Vienna to Salzburg. Recorded at Severance Hall in Cleveland in January 2022.

programme.title: London Symphony Orchestra & Michael Tilson Thomas
programme.desc: American conductor Michael Tilson Thomas leads the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in an energetic performance of Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky's folk-infused Symphony No. 2 in C minor, Op. 17. Written in 1872, the work is nicknamed 'Little Russian' as the composer used several folk tunes from Ukraine, then known as ‘Little Russia'. This performance was recorded at LSO St Luke's, London, on May 31, 2021.

programme.title: Quatuor Ebène
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer's sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven's 650 pages of sheet music. Their efforts culminated in the performance of the composer's complete repertoire for string quartet, which covers three decades of Beethoven's musical creativity, during six impressive concerts at Philharmonie de Paris in the autumn of 2020. Quatuor Ébène explored every facet of Beethoven's string quartet repertoire: from the youthful Opus 18 string quartets to the Razumovsky, Harp, and Serioso quartets (Opus 59, 74, and 95) from his middle period, and finally, the depth of his late quartets (Opus 127 to 135). This program features Quatuor Ébène performing Beethoven's String Quartet No. 6 in B-flat major, Op. 18 No. 6 and String Quartet No. 15 in A minor, Op. 132. This concert performance was recorded at Philharmonie de Paris on November 24, 2020.

programme.title: Sinne Eeg & Jimmy J¢rgensen
programme.desc: It's going to be fast, really fast! All your favourite characters from the world of cartoons and animated films in the Concert Hall - together with a strong fusion of musicians and singers from DR's choirs and orchestras. Cartoons are for children and adults alike - and the music in them is at least as entertaining as the pictures! It will be fun, touching, crazy and dramatic when the Concert Hall is filled with living lines drawn in tones in the big room. The DR Symphony Orchestra, DR Big Band and DR Vocal Ensemble have joined forces to take you to a party in the cartoon universes.

programme.title: Eric Clapton & Steve Winwood
programme.sub-title: Eric Clapton & Steve Winwood - Live from MSG
programme.desc: History rocked and rock made history during a sold-out three-gig stand at Madison Square Garden in late February 2008 when icons Eric Clapton and Steve Winwood performed a concert together for the first time since their all-too-brief days in the legendary Blind Faith in 1969. Whether they will ever team again is unknown. But with Eric Clapton and Steve Winwood Live From Madison Square Garden fans everywhere are able to experience the sound and the glory of a performance on that famous stage by two of rock's greatest artists.

programme.title: Alanis Morissette
programme.desc: Alanis Morissette is one of the most successful female artists and songwriters of all time and has sold in excess of 60 million albums worldwide. Her voice is instantly recognisable and she is a consummate live performer. On 2 July 2012 Alanis Morissette returned to Montreux as part of her Guardian Angel Tour in support of her latest album "Havoc And Bright Lights". It was her third appearance at the festival. The set showcased a number of tracks from the new album alongside classic tracks from across her career. programme.title: Culpable sin rostro
programme.desc: India, 1880. Honor, deber, respeto. La eterna moral, el código ético militar. Todos estos valores corren peligro en un regimiento donde una hermosa viuda de un insigne héroe de guerra es atacada por uno de los nuevos oficiales.

programme.title: El valle oscuro
programme.desc: Un jinete solitario llega a un remoto y aislado pueblo de los Alpes austríacos, donde, a pesar de no ser bienvenido, se le permite quedarse antes del duro invierno. Se presenta como un fotógrafo de Estados Unidos, pero nadie sospecha que el misterioso extranjero ha llegado al valle para cumplir una venganza. La violencia flota en el aire en este pueblo de leñadores, dominado por un viejo clan familiar que impone sus leyes, aterrorizando a sus habitantes.

programme.title: La ola
programme.desc: El experimento de un profesor de instituto para demostrar a sus alumnos cómo es la vida bajo una dictadura se descontrola terriblemente cuando forma una unidad social con vida propia.

programme.desc: Ganadora del Oscar a Mejor Actriz (Meryl Streep) y dirigida por Alan Pakula (El informe Pelícano). Stingo, un joven con ambiciones literarias se traslada a Brooklyn, donde conoce a una inmigrante polaca llamada Sophie, una superviviente de Auschwitz...

programme.title: La Letra Con Sangre Entra
programme.desc: Durante la pandemia, un maestro agotado al borde de un colapso escucha a sus alumnos burlándose de él en una clase de Zoom y jura venganza.

programme.title: Alta Mar
programme.desc: Tres parejas celebran un cumpleaños en un yate para pasar un lujoso fin de semana. Tras la noche todo parece en calma, pero nada más lejos de la realidad. Su pesadilla acaba de empezar.

programme.title: La casa del terror
programme.desc: En Halloween, seis amigos deciden entrar en una casa encantada que promete ofrecer una experiencia extrema a base de explotar sus miedos más profundos.

programme.title: Los elegidos (Dark Skies)
programme.desc: Los Barret son una familia que vive en los suburbios. Lacey y Daniel presencian una serie de extraños acontecimientos perturbadores que afectan a su familia, a su seguridad y a su tranquilidad. Pronto descubren que su familia es el objetivo de una inimaginable y terrorífica fuerza mortal.

programme.title: Asuntos de familia
programme.desc: Nazaret en la actualidad: una pareja de ancianos vive cansada del ritmo de su rutina diaria. En el otro lado de la frontera, en Ramallah, su hijo desea seguir siendo un eterno soltero, su hija está a punto de dar a luz mientras el marido de esta consigue un papel en una película.

programme.title: EFC: Combate Extremo
programme.desc: La actual campeona de artes marciales mixtas Cassady Jones se enfrenta a la estrella en ascenso Alexa Star en un enfrentamiento explosivo que sacude el EFC, con el futuro del deporte en juego.

programme.title: Eisenstein en Guanajuato
programme.desc: 1931, tras el éxito mundial de su película "El Acorazado Potemkin", el director Sergei Eisenstein viaja a la ciudad de Guanajuato, Mejico, para rodar una nueva película. Rechazado por la implacable industria de Hollywood, Eisenstein se deja seducir por el encanto y la frescura de su nuevo destino.

programme.title: Tránsito
programme.desc: Historia de suspense de un psiquiatra de Nueva York que intenta detener el suicidio planeado de un joven paciente inusual en la víspera de su 21 cumpleaños.

programme.title: La ola
programme.desc: Excelente y multipremiada cinta basada en hechos reales sobre la escalofriante historia de un profesor que, para explicar los regímenes autoritarios, idea un expermiento consistente en implantar un régimen de extrema disciplina militar en el aula. El experimento se convertirá en una pesadilla.

programme.title: Lejos de la tierra quemada
programme.desc: Ópera prima de Guillermo Arriaga como director. Cuatro intensas historias en torno al amor.

programme.desc: Una adolescente nerd finge ser su hermosa y falsa hermana gemela de California para convertirse en la chica más popular de la escuela secundaria, pero cuando las cosas no salen exactamente según lo planeado, aprende que ser tú mismo es más importante.

programme.title: La partida
programme.desc: Dos chicos cubanos al borde de la marginalidad se enamoran y luchan por llevar una vida juntos.

programme.title: La vida sin ti
programme.desc: Laurent Larivière vuelve con un enigmático drama que desvela lentamente el misterio de la vida de una mujer, interpretada por Isabelle Huppert, mientras rememora los recuerdos más felices y oscuros de su vida, entre Francia, Irlanda y Alemania.

programme.title: Novia Por Conveniencia
programme.desc: Una novia rusa que quiere conseguir el permiso de residencia es encargada porcorreo. Ella intenta compaginar su vida amorosa con su marido rico pero en bancarrota y su amante desaliñada pero encantadora.

programme.title: Bright Star
programme.desc: John Keats, joven poeta inglés de 23 años, y su vecina Fanny, una extrovertida y elegante estudiante, no se llevan nada bien. Ella no está impresionada por su poesía y él la ve como una persona superficial. Pero cuando Fanny descubre que Keats cuida de su hermano enfermo, le pide que le enseñe sus poemas y poco a poco la relación entre los dos jóvenes empezará a cambiar, hasta terminar convirtiéndose en una profunda y verdadera historia de amor.

programme.title: Bloodsucking bastards
programme.desc: Evan es un empleado obediente y sobrecargado de trabajo, atrapado en una empresa que le explota, al igual que a su novia Amanda y a su holgazán mejor amigo Tim. El frágil mundo de Evan termina de desmoronarse cuando su jefe, Ted, le concede el ansiado ascenso a su némesis en la empresa, Max. Pero todo eso no será nada comparado con el secreto que está a punto de descubrir, que pondrá su vida y la de sus compañeros en peligro.

programme.title: El espejo de los otros
programme.desc: Existe en Buenos Aires un lugar que pocos conocen, pero del que casi todo el mundo habla. Es Cenáculo, un restaurante único que se encuentra en las ruinas de una catedral gótica. Tiene únicamente una mesa y todas las noches ofrece una “última cena”. Nadie viene solo a disfrutar de la comida, los vinos y la música, los comensales que se sientan a cenar, transforman sus vidas. Por Cenáculo pasa el amor, la vida, la muerte, la codicia y la soledad.

programme.title: Juerga Hasta El Fin
programme.desc: Durante una fiesta celebrada en Los Angeles con motivo de la inauguración de la nueva casa de James Franco, los también actores Seth Rogen, Jay Baruchel y otras celebridades se enfrentan al Apocalipsis del fin del mundo pronosticado por los mayas.

programme.title: Mis Otros Yo
programme.desc: Doug Kinney es un buen padre, esposo y hombre de negocios pero sin mucho tiempo para dedicar a su familia ni a su trabajo. El experto en genética Owen Leeds le brinda la oportunidad de tomar las riendas de su vida gracias a la clonación. Si la vida ya era complicada con un solo Doug, aún lo será más con múltiples clones. Una divertida comedia que aborda la posibilidad científica de la clonación y el desastre que puede generar.

programme.title: Aventuras En La Casa Branca
programme.desc: Dos adolescentes despistados se ven involucrados sin darse cuenta en el escándalo del Watergate que provocó la caída del gobierno de Nixon.

programme.title: La mujer del látigo
programme.desc: Salvaje Oeste - Para evitar la soga del ahorcado, un vaquero acepta casarse con una bella pero ardiente pelirroja.

programme.title: Abriendo horizontes
programme.desc: Con la Guerra Civil a punto de comenzar, los saboteadores del Sur atacan la construcción del ferrocarril fronterizo.

programme.title: La marca del zorrillo
programme.desc: En la California de los años 1840, un joven aristócrata descubre un poder extraordinario gracias a una misteriosa poción. Convertido en un inesperado defensor de la justicia, deberá enfrentarse a un gobernador corrupto mientras descubre hasta dónde puede llegar su nuevo poder.

programme.title: La reina de Montana
programme.desc: Sierra Nevada Jones debe luchar contra un malvado ranchero para reclamar la tierra que por derecho le pertenece.

programme.title: Código Alfa: Conspiración
programme.desc: Johana, una mujer sin pasado, huye de Bowie, agente de la ONU y director de un programa espacial secreto. En su camino conoce a Martin y, con ayuda de Lance, intenta encontrar a la hija de Martin, mitad alienígena, explorando meditación, telepatía y frecuencias superiores.

programme.title: Not Forgotten
programme.desc: En un pueblo fronterizo de Tex-Mex, un hombre y su mujer deben enfrentarse a sus torturados pasados para salvar a su hija secuestrada.

programme.title: Flor de Azúcar
programme.desc: Un joven campesino se ve obligado a huir por matar involuntariamente a un guardia abusivo. Tras un año entero escondido en una remota isla pesquera, decide regresar a su campo y reunirse con su mujer y sus hijas.

programme.title: Lleno de ruido y dolor
programme.desc: Soria se une a dos bandidos para robar un banco de un pequeño pueblo de la Patagonia. Pronto se da cuenta de que ha cometido el mayor error de su vida cuando se ve obligado a matar a un inocente.

programme.title: Exorcismo en Georgia
programme.desc: Poco después de trasladarse a su nueva casa en Georgia una pareja se entera de que su hija tiene misteriosas visiones de personas que nadie más que ella parece ver. Finalmente ellos también son testigos de extraños fenómenos que tienen lugar alrededor de la casa y que van aportando pistas de lo que podría ser un escalofriante misterio que se ha mantenido en secreto durante generaciones.

programme.title: The Princess Blade
programme.desc: Yuki pertenece a un grupo de guerreros mercenarios, los Takemikazuchi, largamente empleados por el actual gobierno para vencer a la facción rebelde contrarios a su política déspota. Esta banda de samurais modernos se rige por un sólido código del honor mas cercano a las antiguas ordenes feudales que a una organización pseudo-criminal. Yuki, descendiente directa de la rama consanguínea de los fundadores del clan descubrirá que su madre fue asesinada por el actual dirigente del mismo cuando intentó poner fin a las maniobras de sus miembros. Consciente de ello Yuki se volverá contra sus camaradas y tendrá que liberarse de sus deberes para ser libre.

programme.title: Aprendiz de gigoló
programme.desc: Dos amigos judíos de edad avanzada (Allen y Turturro) se encuentran ante una desesperada situación financiera. Deciden entonces probar suerte con el negocio de la prostitución masculina, uno como gigoló y el otro como "representante". Pero el asunto no será bien visto en la comunidad judía en la que viven.

programme.title: La maldición (The Grudge)
programme.desc: Rika cuida a una anciana señora que vive en una casa en la que suceden cosas extrañas. Un día se encuentra en el piso de arriba a un niño de seis años que lleva un gato negro en los brazos...

programme.title: Un golpe a la inglesa
programme.desc: XXX (Matthew Goode) es un delincuente profesional con muchos contactos. Tras pasar tres años a la sombra por robar una casa victoriana londinense,sale de la cárcel con nuevas amistades y un plan: robar el depósito de seguridad de Hatton Garden, el barrio de las joyerías de Londres. En cuanto salta el rumor de que se está planeando dar el golpe del siglo, Marcus Ford (Stephen Moyer) recurre a un antiguo inspector jefe de Scotland Yard con un pasado corrupto en busca de información. Marcus quiere recuperar el contenido de una de las cajas de seguridad antes de que caiga en las manos equivocadas.

programme.title: Zaniki
programme.desc: Zaniki admira a su abuelo, un paisano que parece salido de un cuento. Eusebio canta, baila y sobre todo, sabe hacer música con infinidad de objetos, convirtiendo así el día a día de la familia en un escenario constante.

programme.title: Una piraña en el bidé
programme.desc: Julia quiere que sus padres separados, vuelvan a juntarse. Para ello consigue que su padre y su niñera África, que viven juntos, se peleen, y que África conquiste a Alejo, el compañero de su madre. Pero su madre se ha enamorado de Jorge, con el que espera un hijo.

programme.title: Magical Girl
programme.desc: El padre de una niña con una enfermedad terminal está decidido a conceder el último deseo de su hija, un disfraz de coleccionista, ridículamente caro, de una serie de televisión japonesa. La petición lo conducirá a adentrarse en los oscuros y bajos fondos de su ciudad.

programme.title: Arena en los bolsillos
programme.desc: Iván, Lionel, Jenny y Elena, cuatro jóvenes de un barrio de la periferia de Madrid, inician un viaje hacia el mar huyendo de las miserias que les rodean. En el camino encontrarán amor y solidaridad, todo aquello que no tienen en su entorno. A su paso dejarán su firma en las paredes...

programme.title: Amateurs
programme.desc: Marsella (Francia): El día que Blanca cumple 16 años, su madre muere sepultada bajo tres toneladas de pescado, quedando sola en la vida. Vallecas (Madrid): Julio Nieves, un fornido capataz de la construcción de 65 años, cae desplomado en su ducha. A partir de ahora se enfrenta a su dura jubilación.
